entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is VF-881-92B.

Okay, I can certainly help with that. Let me just pull up that order. I see it's for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered eight days ago. To get this started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. It's not for me. Look, I tried to do this online yesterday but your whole return portal was down. I just need a label.

My apologies for that trouble. We did have a known issue yesterday; the entire return system was down for maintenance. That was an unexpected website error on our part, and a few customers reported they couldn't print their labels.
Right. So can you send me the label?
Yes, absolutely. Just for our records of the outage, did you happen to grab a screenshot of the error message when the system was down?
No, I didn't take a screenshot. I'm busy, I don't have time for that. I just need to get this sent back. Is that going to be a problem?

Not a problem at all. I have confirmation of the outage in our internal logs. And since you're well within the 90-day return period, I can approve this for you right now. I've just generated the prepaid shipping label and sent it to the email on file. You should see it in your inbox shortly.
Okay, I've got it. Finally. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
